# 3-Day Beginner Full-Body Plan (Dumbbells Only)

Train **Mon / Wed / Fri** (rest days in between) for 3–4 weeks per block. Before every session: **5 min easy cardio** (walk, jog in place, bike) + 2–3 light ramp-up sets on the first lift. Work to **1–2 reps in reserve** — leave a little in the tank.

## Monday — Day A
| Exercise | Sets × Reps | Rest |
|---|---|---|
| Goblet squat (one dumbbell at chest) | 3 × 8–12 | 90 s |
| Push-up (knees are fine) | 3 × 6–12 | 60–90 s |
| Bent-over dumbbell row | 3 × 10–12 | 60 s |
| Romanian deadlift (both hands) | 3 × 10–12 | 90 s |
| Seated/standing dumbbell overhead press | 3 × 8–12 | 60–90 s |

**Cardio:** 20–30 min brisk walk (or 10–15 min easy bike) at a conversational pace — builds the base without wrecking recovery.

## Wednesday — Day B
| Exercise | Sets × Reps | Rest |
|---|---|---|
| Dumbbell step-up | 3 × 8–10 per leg | 60–90 s |
| Dumbbell floor press | 3 × 8–12 | 90 s |
| One-arm dumbbell row | 3 × 10–12 per side | 60 s |
| Dumbbell swing (hip hinge) | 3 × 12–15 | 60 s |
| Plank | 3 × 20–40 s | 45 s |

**Cardio:** 15–20 min brisk walk or low-impact cycling, light-to-moderate effort.

## Friday — Day A
| Exercise | Sets × Reps | Rest |
|---|---|---|
| Goblet squat (one dumbbell at chest) | 3 × 8–12 | 90 s |
| Push-up (knees are fine) | 3 × 6–12 | 60–90 s |
| Bent-over dumbbell row | 3 × 10–12 | 60 s |
| Romanian deadlift (both hands) | 3 × 10–12 | 90 s |
| Seated/standing dumbbell overhead press | 3 × 8–12 | 60–90 s |

**Cardio:** 20–30 min brisk walk (or 10–15 min easy bike) at a conversational pace.

## Progression
- **Double progression:** when you hit the top of the rep range on all sets, add the smallest step (2.5 kg upper body / 5 kg lower) and restart at the bottom of the range — makes steady progress measurable and safe.
- **Deload week 5:** cut total sets ~40% (keep the weights), then resume.

## Safety Notes
1. **Sharp or joint pain = stop** and see a professional; normal muscle soreness is fine.
2. Learn each movement with light or no weight first — form before load prevents most beginner injuries.
3. Don't grind to total failure at beginner loads; those extra reps cost recovery you can't afford 3×/week.

recipe = """# Fluffy Buttermilk-Style Pancakes (Serves 4)

Makes about 8–10 pancakes. Total time: about 30 minutes (15 min prep, 15–20 min cooking).

## Ingredients
- 250 g (2 cups) all-purpose flour
- 2 tsp baking powder
- 1/2 tsp baking soda (optional, for extra fluff)
- 1/2 tsp salt
- 2 tbsp sugar
- 2 large eggs
- 500 ml (about 2 cups) whole milk
- 60 g (1/4 cup) melted butter
- Extra butter or oil for the pan

## Method
1. **Mix dry (3 min):** Whisk the flour, baking powder, baking soda, salt and sugar in a large bowl.
2. **Mix wet (2 min):** Whisk the eggs and milk in another bowl, then stir in the melted butter.
3. **Combine (2 min):** Pour the wet mix into the dry and stir until *just* combined — a few small lumps are fine. Don't overmix.
4. **Rest (5 min):** Let the batter stand for 5 minutes. It will thicken slightly.
5. **Cook (15–20 min):** Heat a non-stick pan or griddle over medium heat and brush lightly with butter. Pour about 60 ml (1/4 cup) of batter per pancake. Cook 2–3 minutes, until bubbles form on top and the edges look set. Flip and cook 1–2 minutes more until golden.
6. **Keep warm:** Stack finished pancakes on a plate in a 150 °C (300 °F) oven while you cook the rest.

## Serving
- 2–3 pancakes per person with maple syrup, butter and fresh berries.
- Optional mix-ins (about 100 g): chocolate chips, sliced banana, blueberries or grated apple — fold into the batter at step 3.

## Tips
- Batter should coat the back of a spoon; thin it with a splash of milk if too thick.
- If pancakes brown too fast, drop the heat a little.
"""
